categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in two primary business segments: (1) Advertising business, including outdoor LED screen media operations, internet advertising placement, and integrated marketing services; and (2) Film and television content business, including investment, production, and distribution of TV dramas, films, web dramas, and variety shows. The company has transformed from a pure outdoor LED screen operator into a full-scenario integrated marketing service provider.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include outdoor LED screen display technology, with innovations such as 3D naked-eye displays and 8K resolution screens. For film and television production, the company employs a complete integrated system covering pre-production planning, script creation, content production and filming, post-production, and distribution. The company utilizes market-based valuation techniques and comprehensive project management systems for content development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include advertising clients in high-margin industries such as premium spirits, cosmetics, and luxury watches. Film and television customers are primarily television stations and video streaming platforms. The company serves both direct clients and channel-based customers. Major end markets include first and second-tier developed cities in China, with particular strength in Shanghai, Beijing, and Guangzhou.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with major operations in Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and other first and second-tier cities. The company also maintains a Hong Kong subsidiary (New Culture Media Hong Kong Limited) for international operations. Geographic coverage includes operations in Xinjiang through Holguos Screen Advertising Limited. The company has a small presence in overseas markets through its Hong Kong entity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the media and entertainment supply chain. In advertising, it operates midstream as a media resource operator and advertising service provider, purchasing media resources and reselling advertising placement services to brands. In film and television, it operates across the full value chain from content production (upstream) through distribution and licensing (downstream), serving as both producer and distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) optimizing media resource allocation and reducing fixed costs of outdoor screens; (2) upgrading screen technology with 3D and 8K capabilities; (3) expanding online advertising platforms and internet channel partnerships; (4) pursuing content quality and brand positioning in film and television; (5) developing integrated marketing solutions combining online and offline channels; and (6) exploring new business models and revenue streams while managing financial leverage.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Advertising business revenue from outdoor LED screen placements, internet advertising platform services, and integrated marketing solutions; (2) Film and television content revenue from licensing broadcast rights (first-run and subsequent-run television rights), film box office revenue sharing, platform licensing fees, and overseas distribution; (3) Ancillary revenue from content-related services. Revenue recognition follows the performance obligation satisfaction model, with advertising recognized upon broadcast and content recognized upon delivery of broadcast rights.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the outdoor advertising segment, the company competes with other LED screen operators and traditional media companies. The company positions itself as a leading outdoor LED screen media operator with premium screen locations in major commercial districts. In film and television, the company competes with other production and distribution companies. The company differentiates through its integrated media platform combining advertising and content, premium screen locations in landmark commercial areas, and accumulated experience in high-end consumer brand marketing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported 2022 revenue of 126.04 million yuan, down 11.51% from 142.44 million yuan in 2021. The company reported a net loss of 154.62 million yuan in 2022 compared to 649.64 million yuan loss in 2021, representing a 76.20% improvement. Total assets were 1.087 billion yuan at year-end 2022 versus 714.01 million yuan in 2021. The company faces significant financial challenges with negative equity of 69.39 million yuan and substantial debt obligations, leading to delisting risk.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing integrated, full-scenario marketing solutions combining premium outdoor LED screen media with content creation capabilities. Key differentiators include: (1) premium screen locations in landmark commercial districts of major cities; (2) accumulated relationships with high-end consumer brands in spirits, cosmetics, and luxury goods; (3) integrated content and media platform enabling multi-channel campaigns; (4) advanced display technology including 3D and 8K capabilities; and (5) comprehensive production and distribution expertise in film and television content creation.
